about.title: About the firm
about.subtitle: Asor — Certified Public Accountants, founded on the belief that quality financial guidance is much more than tallying numbers at year-end.
about.p1: Our firm provides personal, professional, and comprehensive service, tailored precisely to each client's financial needs. We stand for reliability, transparency, and the pursuit of excellence — and we accompany our clients at every stage of business life.
about.p2: Our team combines deep professional knowledge with a personal, attentive approach. We believe that every client deserves direct access to a professional who knows their business deeply, and who can support strategic decisions — not just technical ones.
about.p3: Alongside our core CPA services — audit, bookkeeping, and taxation — we have developed a unique specialty in real estate, Pinui-Binui, and TAMA 38, an area that requires combined knowledge of accounting, taxation, and the complexities of the Israeli real estate world.

privacy.title: Privacy & cookies policy
privacy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the Israeli Privacy Protection Law, 5741-1981, as amended by Amendment No. 13, and the regulations under it.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy (the "Policy") describes what information Asor CPA (the "Firm", "we") collects through this website and its landing pages, for what purpose, to whom it is passed, and your rights regarding it. Every form on the site shows a short notice under section 11 of the Law, which this Policy details.
privacy.controllerInfo: Database controller: Asor CPA, company no. 515367779, 17 Nahum Hefetzadi St., Givat Shaul, Jerusalem (Migdal Ram, 11th floor). Phone 02-5000275, email office@za-cpa.com. Privacy contact: Orit Asor, CPA, 052-3975659. Registrations for Orit Asor's groups and courses are handled by Orit Asor, orit@za-cpa.com.
privacy.lawText: Information is collected and processed in accordance with the Privacy Protection Law, 5741-1981 (the "Law"), as amended inter alia by the Privacy Protection Law (Amendment No. 13), 5784-2024; the Privacy Protection (Data Security) Regulations, 5777-2017; the Privacy Protection (Transfer of Data to Databases Abroad) Regulations, 5761-2001; and, regarding advertising messages, section 30A of the Communications (Telecommunications and Broadcasting) Law, 5742-1982.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect the following types of information, only to the extent necessary:
collectItems: Information you provide in the site's forms and landing pages: full name, phone, email, message, and depending on the form, the requested service or file type, a preferred date and discount eligibility.
Technical information sent automatically while browsing, such as IP address and browser type, used to display and secure the site and to filter automated (spam) submissions.
Preferences stored only in your browser (local storage): interface language, accessibility settings and cookie choices. This is not sent to us.
As of the date of this Policy, the site does not use third-party analytics, advertising or tracking tools.
privacy.collectNote: Information is collected directly from you or automatically via your browser. Providing details in our forms is not required by law, but without them we cannot get back to you. We do not request information of special sensitivity, as defined in section 3 of the Law, and ask that you not include such information in your message.
privacy.useTitle: Purposes for which information is collected
useItems: Responding to your enquiry, getting back to you and arranging the service or registration you requested.
Managing our relationship with clients and prospective clients, including an internal daily enquiries report.
Meeting legal and professional obligations that apply to accountants, including document retention.
Securing the site and detecting and preventing fraud, spam and misuse.
Sending advertising messages or newsletters, only with your explicit prior consent.
privacy.legalBasisIntro: We process personal information on one or more of the following bases:
legalBasisItems: Your express consent — when you fill out a contact form, accept optional cookies, or join a mailing list
Performance of an engagement with you — for the provision of the professional services you requested
Legal obligation — including reporting, bookkeeping, and document retention duties imposed on the firm by tax law, the CPA Law, 1955, and other laws
The firm's legitimate interest — service improvement, information security, and prevention of misuse — balanced against your rights
privacy.cookiesIntro: The site currently places no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. Your preferences (language, accessibility and cookie choices) are stored only in your browser's local storage. If optional cookies are introduced in the future, they will be activated only after your consent via the cookie banner, and this Policy will be updated.
privacy.cookiesEssential: Essential storage: saving your language, accessibility settings and cookie choices. Required for the site to work and kept on your device only.
privacy.cookiesAnalytics: Analytics cookies: not currently used. If introduced, they will load only after your consent.
privacy.cookiesMarketing: Marketing cookies: not currently used. If introduced, they will load only after your explicit consent.
privacy.cookiesRetention: Preferences remain in your browser until you delete them, which you can do at any time in your browser settings.
privacy.cookiesManage: You can update or withdraw your consent for optional cookies at any time using the "Manage consent" button at the bottom of every page. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
privacy.retentionText: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes for which it was collected, or longer where the law requires. Enquiries sent through the site are kept on our enquiry server for up to 60 days for the daily report and then deleted automatically. A copy is kept in the Firm's mailbox; enquiries that do not lead to an engagement are kept for up to 24 months. Documents relating to professional services are kept for the period required by tax and professional rules.
privacy.thirdPartyText: We do not sell, rent or trade personal information. To operate the site and deliver enquiries to us we use service providers acting on our behalf, who receive information only as needed: GitHub (site hosting); Cloudflare (enquiry server, security, spam filtering and temporary storage of enquiries); Resend (email delivery); Web3Forms (backup enquiry delivery); Google (the Firm's mailboxes and the Google Fonts service); and cdnjs and Tailwind (design libraries). Information may also be disclosed to a competent authority where the law requires, and as part of professional services to the tax authorities, the Registrar of Companies or others, with your consent.
privacy.internationalText: Some of these providers operate servers outside Israel, so enquiry details and IP addresses may be processed abroad. Such transfers are made in accordance with the Privacy Protection (Transfer of Data to Databases Abroad) Regulations, 5761-2001, based on your consent when submitting details and the providers' data protection terms.
privacy.directMarketingText: We will send you advertising messages, such as newsletters or offers, only if you have given explicit prior consent, in accordance with section 30A of the Communications Law. Every such message will include a simple way to opt out, which we will honour. An automatic confirmation that we received your enquiry is not an advertising message and contains no marketing content.
privacy.minorsText: The site is not intended to collect information from minors under the age of 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them without parental or legal-guardian consent. If you become aware that a minor has submitted information through the site without appropriate consent, please contact us and we will act promptly to delete the information.
privacy.rightsIntro: The Law grants you the following rights regarding personal information held about you:
rightsItems: The right to review personal information held about you (section 13 of the Law).
The right to request correction or deletion of information that is not accurate, complete, clear or up to date (section 14 of the Law).
The right to withdraw any consent you gave at any time, including consent to receive advertising.
The right to opt out of advertising messages (section 30A(d) of the Communications Law).
The right to contact the Privacy Protection Authority if you believe your rights were infringed.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise your rights, contact us using the details at the bottom of this page. We will address your request within 30 days; if additional time is required we will inform you accordingly.
privacy.securityText: We take reasonable security measures in accordance with the Privacy Protection (Data Security) Regulations, 5777-2017, including encrypted communication (HTTPS), password-only access to admin interfaces, rate limiting and filtering of automated submissions. If a severe security incident as defined in the Regulations occurs, we will report it to the Privacy Protection Authority as required, and notify affected data subjects where we are required to. No online security method is absolute.
privacy.complaintTitle: Right to file a complaint with the Privacy Protection Authority
privacy.complaintText: If you believe your right to privacy has been infringed and you have not received an appropriate response from us, you may file a complaint with the Privacy Protection Authority at the Israeli Ministry of Justice, via the Authority's website (privacy.gov.il) or by mail: Privacy Protection Authority, P.O.B. 27338, Jerusalem 9127202.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Policy from time to time, including due to changes in legislation, technology, or our services. The current version is the one published on the site, alongside the last-updated date. In the event of a material change to the Policy, we will take reasonable steps to notify active users.
privacy.contactIntro: For any privacy-related question, request, or comment — including the exercise of statutory rights — please contact our Privacy Coordinator:
privacy.updatedText: This Policy was last updated on {{date}}. The most current version is always available on this page.
privacy.disclaimerText: This document is intended to describe our privacy practices in plain language. In the event of any inconsistency between this document and applicable law, the law shall prevail. Nothing in this Policy diminishes any of your rights under any applicable law.

statement.title: Accessibility statement
statement.subtitle: We are committed to making this site accessible to all users, including people with disabilities.
statement.disclaimerText: We make every effort to keep the site accessible at the highest possible level, even though full accessibility of every part of the site cannot always be achieved. We continue to improve accessibility on an ongoing basis, as part of our commitment to enable use of the site by the entire public, including people with disabilities.
statement.intro: Asor — Certified Public Accountants places great importance on providing equitable and accessible service to all clients, including people with disabilities. The site is being made accessible as part of our effort to enable every individual to receive quality service independently and equally, in accordance with the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law (1998) and the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Accessibility Adjustments to a Service), 2013.
statement.lawText: The site is made accessible in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law, 1998, and the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Regulations (Accessibility Adjustments to a Service), 2013.
statement.standardText: The site and its landing pages are made accessible in accordance with Israeli Standard 5568, based on WCAG 2.0, at level AA, as required by regulation 35A of the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 5773-2013.
statement.methodologyTitle: How the site was made accessible
statement.methodologyText: Accessibility was implemented through code and design adjustments (heading structure, form field labels, colour contrast, alternative text and keyboard support) and checked with an automated testing tool (axe) against WCAG level AA on every page of the site and its landing pages. The latest check was carried out on 1 November 2026, and the issues it found were fixed.
statement.screenReadersText: The site was designed to support assistive technologies and common screen readers. For the best browsing experience, we recommend using an up-to-date version of your screen reader and browser.
statement.keyboardText: The site can be navigated using the keyboard alone: move between elements with Tab (and Shift+Tab to go back), activate with Enter or the Space key, and close dialogs with Esc.
features: A floating accessibility menu available on every page
Semantic heading structure and keyboard navigation
Sufficient color contrast between text and background
statement.limitationsTitle: Areas that are not yet accessible
statement.limitationsIntro: Despite our efforts to make all pages accessible, some parts of the site may not yet be fully accessible, including:
limitations: Third-party content and documents not under the firm's control
Downloadable files uploaded in the past that are not yet fully accessible
Certain interactive components currently in the process of being made accessible
statement.limitationsCommit: We are working to make these items accessible as soon as possible. If you come across content that is not accessible, please let us know and we will address it.
statement.coordinatorIntro: Found an accessibility issue? We'd appreciate hearing from you so we can address it promptly. You can contact our accessibility coordinator:
statement.coordinatorAddressValue: 17 Nahum Heftsadi St., Ram Tower, 11th floor, Jerusalem
statement.responseText: We commit to responding to accessibility inquiries within 14 business days.
statement.individualText: A person with a disability who requires an individual accessibility accommodation in order to receive service from the firm is welcome to contact the accessibility coordinator, and we will do our best to provide a tailored response according to their needs.
statement.complaintText: If you contacted us regarding accessibility and did not receive a satisfactory response, you may contact the Commission for Equal Rights of Persons with Disabilities at the Ministry of Justice. Full details are available on the Commission's website.
statement.ongoingText: We view site accessibility as an ongoing process and work to improve and update it regularly, in order to enable convenient and equal use for all users.
statement.updatedText: This statement was last updated on {{date}}.
